method: Independent exact SymPy literal source/all-sector transport models and noncommutative block formulas; no author code imported. The general normalization and support/rank proof are reviewed in writing.
negative_controls: For the nonconstant scalar unit s, replacing w by I changes the actual normalized native.
Invertibility of the full conditional routing does not imply its first entry is a unit.
scope: R20=0, unit R00 in all four sectors, one declared clock, arbitrary fixed diagonal Q and ordinary outer encodings. Other first pivots and non-diagonal Q remain open. No new complete kappa.
